# Description
Analysis of coding variants in SNP context

# Libraries
```{r Libraries, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(gprofiler2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ontologySimilarity)
library(ontologyIndex)
```

# Loading data
```{r}
loci_in_GRBs <- read_csv("output/loci_in_GRBs_clnv.csv") %>%
  # Maybe remove the next line if it is not there
  select(-X)
clnv <- readRDS("RDS/clinVar.rds")

trg_genes <- read.csv(file = "data/hg19.canFam3.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
```


# loci_clnv
GRB genes and clnv genes are comma separated in columns. loci_clnv contains each grb and clnv gene separated in a row for further analysis. 
```{r}
loci_clnv <- filter(loci_in_GRBs, !is.na(clnv_gene)) %>%
  separate_rows(clnv_gene) %>%
  separate_rows(GRB_GENES) %>%
  separate_rows(GWAS_GENES, sep = ",")

grb_clnv_match <- filter(loci_clnv, GRB_GENES == clnv_gene) %>%
  unique()
grb_clnv_match

gwas_clnv_match <- 
  filter(loci_clnv, GWAS_GENES == clnv_gene) %>% unique()


# Non overlap
grb_clnv_match %>%
  filter(!is.element(SNPS, gwas_clnv_match$SNPS))
```
There are 20 terms where mapped_trait, grb_gene and clnv_gene match up and those are:
* squamous cell carcinoma - FGFR2 
* obesity - BDNF
* Tourette syndrome - SOX5
* atrial fibrillation - HCN4
* atrial fibrillation - KCNJ2
* atrial fibrillation - ANK2

The Tourette syndrome SOX5 example shows that searching for parent terms in the ontology could prove beneficial. Other SNPs in the SOX5 GRB are *obsessive compulsive disorder* and *autism spectrum disorder* and all of them share the parent term of *mental disorders*. Furthermore, autism spectrum disorder and Tourette syndrom share a closer parent of *developmental disorder of mental health*. Additionally, an mendelian disease related to SOX5 is *Lamb-Shaffer syndrome* which is a rare disease with various mental and physical abnormalities.  

Idea? Compare all disease terms. Find closest parent term, calculate some distance score. Have a column. disease term, closest parent, some score. 

```{r}
gost_ <- gost(filter(loci_clnv, MAPPED_TRAIT == "autism spectrum disorder") %>% pull(clnv_gene))

gostplot(gost_)
```



# OntologySimilarity
Example with pairs
```{r}
# Creating ontology index
ontology <- get_ontology(file = "data/mondo.obo") 
test1 <- c("MONDO:0007661", "MONDO:0005258", "MONDO:0008114", "MONDO:0005002")

info_contents <- descendants_IC(ontology)

get_term_sim_mat(ontology = ontology, information_content = info_contents, row_terms = test1, col_terms = test1)
```


```{r, eval=FALSE}
loci_in_GRBs_sep <- loci_in_GRBs
loci_in_GRBs_sep <- loci_in_GRBs_sep %>%
separate_rows(GRB_GENES, sep = ",")
loci_in_GRBs_sep <- loci_in_GRBs_sep %>%
  separate_rows(GWAS_GENES, sep = ",")

saveRDS(loci_in_GRBs_sep, "data/loci_in_GRBs_sep.df.rds")
```

```{r}
loci_in_GRBs_sep <- readRDS("data/loci_in_GRBs_sep.df.rds")

terms_list <- list()

terms_list[[1]] <- filter(loci_in_GRBs_sep, GRB_GENES == "SOX5" & !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique()

terms_list[[2]] <- filter(loci_in_GRBs_sep, GWAS_GENES == "SOX5" & !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique()

terms_list[[3]] <- filter(clnv, gene == "SOX5" & !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique()

get_sim_grid(ontology, information_content = info_contents, term_sets = terms_list) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# Defining empty Dataframe
sim_df_trg <- data.frame(trg_gene=NA,
                         grb_clnv_sim=NA,
                         grb_clnv_p=NA,
                         gwas_clnv_sim=NA,
                         gwas_clnv_p=NA,
                         grb_gwas_sim=NA,
                        grb_gwas_p=NA)
# COunter for loop
counter <- 0


for (gene_id in trg_genes$geneName) {
#for (i in 1:5) {
  # gene name processed stored in gene_id
  #gene_id <- trg_genes$geneName[i]
  checker <- FALSE
  sim_grid <- NA
  terms_list <- list()
  counter <- counter+1
  if(counter%%100==0){print(paste("Counter: ",counter, " gene: ", gene_id))}

  
terms_list[[1]] <- filter(loci_in_GRBs_sep, GRB_GENES == gene_id & !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique()

terms_list[[2]] <- filter(loci_in_GRBs_sep, GWAS_GENES == gene_id & !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique()

terms_list[[3]] <- filter(clnv, gene == gene_id & !is.na(MONDO_ID)) %>%
  pull(MONDO_ID) %>%
  unique()

if(terms_list[[3]] %>% length()== 0){
  print(paste("No disease related to: ", gene_id))
  next}


  tryCatch(sim_grid <- get_sim_grid(ontology, 
                           information_content = info_contents, 
                           term_sets = terms_list),
            error=function(e){
              print(paste("Error on gene: ", gene_id))
              return(checker <- TRUE)})

if(sim_grid %>% length() <= 1){
  #print(terms_list)
  next}

sim_df_trg <- base::rbind(sim_df_trg, 
                          c(trg_gene = gene_id, 
                            grb_clnv_sim=get_sim(sim_grid, 1:3),
                            grb_clnv_p=get_sim_p(sim_grid, 1:3),
                            gwas_clnv_sim=get_sim(sim_grid, 2:3),
                            gwas_clnv_p=get_sim_p(sim_grid, 2:3),
                            grb_gwas_sim=get_sim(sim_grid, 1:2),
                            grb_gwas_sim=get_sim_p(sim_grid, 1:2)))
  
}
```
